The established unital tensor-square criterion then reduces to the stated quadratic inequality. An independent partial-transpose calculation for the singlet factors into the same inequality times a second factor that is nonnegative throughout the parameter square. Endpoint cases are handled separately. The proof therefore covers all quantified parameters without extrapolating from finite experiments.
